    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Excellent air purifier
    This is an amazing air purifier. The price is very reasonable, I like that you can get reasonably priced air filters. This unit has a mesh pre-filter which helps save the life of your main filter especially when you have pets. The unit is very high quality and well built. The controls are easy to use and has a child lock and night mode where you can turn the display off. The app works really well to control it if you desire to hook it up to wireless but you don't need to if you don't want. The app does give you some additional functionality like it shows you your filter life percentage that it calculates based on an algorithm of the air quality and fan speed. The app also has a reminder for cleaning the pre-filter. The blower is very quiet on speeds 1 and 2 and then 3 and 4 are noticeably louder and I would probably only run it on that setting if you are needing to clean the air faster. It does have an auto mode but it shows my indoor air quality is very good and I still want it to keep filtering the air so I leave it on 2 24/7. Overall I highly recommend this air purifier.

I finally decided to buy one during Amazon Prime Days in June. I researched air purifiers and decided on Levoit since I've read many good things about this brand. The filters last a very long time since they can be vacuumed and reused. I love this purifier and have bought a second smaller one for my bedroom.

      Reviewed in the United States on August 19, 2026

      The LEVOIT Vital 200S-P Air Purifier is AHAM certified, meaning it has been independently tested by the Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers for air-cleaning performance, safety, and energy efficiency. Products with the AHAM VERIFIDE seal meet strict appliance-performance standards, giving added confidence in their ability to improve indoor air quality. This air purifier is designed with allergy sufferers in mind, helping capture common airborne irritants such as pollen, pet hair, dander, and dust. Its efficient filtration system traps tiny particles to support fresher, cleaner air for you and your family. Built for spaces up to 1,875 square feet, the Vital 200S-P is a strong choice for living rooms, bedrooms, basements, open-concept homes, high-traffic areas, and households with pets. A traditional air inlet works together with an additional U-shaped air inlet to help capture airborne pet hair and odors more efficiently while reducing the chance of clogs, so the purifier can keep air moving smoothly.

      Verified CADR Ratings

      The Vital 200S-P has been tested with the following Clean Air Delivery Rate ratings:

      • Smoke: 250 CFM

      • Dust: 254 CFM

      • Pollen: 289 CFM

      After looking at several air purifiers, this LEVOIT looked to be exactly what I was looking for. It received complimentary reviews and was reasonably priced. It is very quiet and comes with the option to turn the control panel lights off, perfect for bedroom use during the night. This has been a great purchase for my family.

I happened to get it a little on sale, and while the cost is a little high, it has proven its worth to the penny. It comes with multiple speeds, modes, and most importantly the sleep function. I also see a vast improvement on my air quality and I no longer wake up the whole household at night with my coughing. It does its best work in one room, but I have noticed that the room its in has less dust. Ive also noticed it is a little if a deoderizor, which is great for someone who has a sensitive nose. Overall, yes its a little expensive upfront but the design of it, the quality of its work, and being able to finally sleep through the night is priceless.       5 out of 5 stars
      This is my 5th Levoit in my home that has 7 total purifiers
      Reviewed in the United States on March 4, 2025
      Style: Air PurifierColor: White
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I've recently replaced some purifiers with the Levoit models. My VERY expensive Aeris no longer had a functioning app after Roomba bought the company out, so I tossed it and got a Core 400. I liked it so much that over the last 2 weeks I got another Core 400, this 200S-P, also today they delivered a 100S-P for the smaller bedroom, and I have another small core one for the master bathroom to keep down the dust.

      So out of seven purifiers, where I used to have five manufacturer's products, I only have three now.

      I don't use them for air quality, I don't have breathing issues. I just like the reduced dust. Since my son graduated and moved out nearly 3 years ago, I live in the house alone, and am not a fan of dusting. So all these purifiers really help cut that down.

      They run silently in auto mode. And unlike the others, when they do kick into high, they're not NEARLY as annoyingly loud. Even the bigger Core-400 at the highest setting is only about as loud as the nearby Air+Health that's in the connected great room when it's about 30 to 40%. The sensors are really capable of noting things. Tonight was the first time that the purifiers in the first two bedrooms on the OTHER SIDE of the house from the kitchen noticed and responded to the changes in the air when I was cooking chicken on the stovetop. Tonight is also the first time I had Levoit in them instead of the Winix ones that these replaced today, when the Winix smart apps stopped working right and I couldn't do schedules anymore.

      The prices are so much better than the expensive ones (this one was LESS than 1/5th the cost of that Aeris I tossed out last week) but they are just as effective in my house. And the control via the app is superb. I already had some smart devices using the VeSync app, so adding these was a breeze. No need to activate a wireless access point on the devices to connect your phone or something - simply hold the power button down until the wifi light blinks, and VeSync finds them right away. A quick firmware update and they were up and running. And I love the fact that they UPDATE their firmware in these things...

      You can't go wrong with any of these models. I'm loving all of them so far.

    • Damon Yorke
      1 out of 5 stars
      No es True HEPA certificado, sensor de pésima calidad, publicidad engañosa
      Reviewed in Mexico on April 12, 2026
      Style: Air PurifierColor: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Pros:

      - Disminuye un poco el polvo en la habitación

      Contras:

      - No sirve para los 1875 pies cuadrados (174m2) que indica en su publicidad. En efectos prácticos sólo sirve para 388 pies cuadrados (36m2) como lo indica en la última foto la publicación. Se requieren más de cuatro cambios de aire por hora para que un filtro de aire sea efectivo y esa cantidad sólo la alcanza en un cuarto de 36m2 y a MÁXIMA VELOCIDAD (punto importante).

      - Sólo es grado HEPA a MÍNIMA VELOCIDAD. Lo pueden consultar en la página oficial del producto. No es un filtro HEPA certificado. Incluso quitaron la leyenda de filtro HEPA del propio filtro, como se observa en la imagen. Los obligaron a remover algo que, básicamente, era falsa publicidad.

      - A MÁXIMA VELOCIDAD además de no ser HEPA fácilmente alcanza 60db de ruido, más menos, como se escucha en el video. Es extremadamente silencioso en primera velocidad para dormir, pero en tercera y cuarta no es para que estés dentro del mismo cuarto.

      - El sensor siempre esta en azul, calidad de aire "óptima". Aún encerrándolo en un cuarto donde hay moho es incapaz de detectar dichas partículas. Sólo se pone en rojo cuando barres el cuarto dónde se encuentra el filtro, sólo detecta partículas verdaderamente grandes. Ni al cocinar frente a él baja la "calidad del aire", aún si se te está quemando la comida. Así que el modo automático básicamente no sirve de mucho. Esto contando que el sensor se limpió y calibró como se indica en las instrucciones. Casi casi tienes que encender y apagar un cerillo frente al sensor para que detecte el humo y la luz pase de azul a roja.

      - Trae muy poco carbón, si tu problema es olores, te vas a consumir este filtro en semanas o pocos meses, no en 1 año.

      - Plástico barato de muy mala calidad. El panel se rayó a la primera pasada de una tela de microfibra. En las fotos se ven detalles de lo barato que se ven todos los materiales

    • brittny blain
      5 out of 5 stars
      WORTH EVERY PENNY
      Reviewed in Canada on March 24, 2025
      Style: Air PurifierColor: White
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Honestly I've been eyeing a levoit air purifier for about a year. I thought it was a tad expensive but I finally bit the bullet. When I say I've put this to the test it's no joke! I've been learning acrylic nails and if anyone has been around monomer you know it's extremely potent and it smells my house up for about 2 days! I was starting to worry about the effects it may have on my children so this is what made me ultimately spend the money on one. When I first plugged it in it said air quality was "moderate" so i busted out the monomer and within 5 seconds my air quality went to "bad" It kicked in immediately (I had already set it up to wifi) and I kid you not within 10-15 minutes my air quality was up to "good" I left the monomer out to test it as I went for a walk and when I came home I was expecting the monomer smell to hit me in the face but it didnt!!! I was gone for about a half hour and I could only smell it once I went up to my room and stood beside it and it wasnt strong at all. To keep testing it I've left the monomer out all day and evening and my air purifier will kick in when the air quality goes below "good" which i love as it only comes on when needed. The monomers been out for about 8.5 hrs and i am just blown away. I forgot to mention the purifier is about 5 feet from it and i just checked the air quality and it's "very good" and i can't even smell it when i am beside it now! There is no better test than this! I also love that there is a setting so it'll detect light and if it's night time and dark (your sleeping) the displays lights won't shine, they stay dark. I should also mention i bought a chemical filter (green) one for it but wanted to see the power of the filter it came with so that's what I've used. Another great thing is even on high it's not super loud and like I said doesn't run consistently. I got the 200s so it does up to 1900 sq ft and is the larger model but it's very sleek and modern so I don't mind! I can feel the quality in my air now. It's so odd. I HIGHLY recommend Levoit air purifiers. You won't regret it! Oh it also has a pet mode!! I should also mention the filters do not need to be changed often. They recommend once every 9 months. I also love how it connects directly to my phone and my alexa so I can use voice control or control it when i am not home!

I HIGHLY recommend Levoit air purifiers. You won't regret it! Oh it also has a pet mode!! I should also mention the filters do not need to be changed often. They recommend once every 9 months. I also love how it connects directly to my phone and my alexa so I can use voice control or control it when i am not home!
